an5.106:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
an5.106:1.2: athakho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an5.106:2.1: kittāvatā nu kho bhante bhikkhusaṃgho viharanto phāsuṃ vihareyyāti.
an5.106:2.2: yato kho ānanda bhikkhu attanā sīlasampanno hoti no paraṃ adhisīle sampavattā
an5.106:2.3: ettāvatāpi kho ānanda bhikkhusaṃgho viharanto phāsuṃ vihareyyāti.
an5.106:3.1: siyā pana bhante aññopi pariyāyo yathā bhikkhusaṃgho viharanto phāsuṃ vihareyyāti.
an5.106:3.3: yato kho ānanda bhikkhu attanā ca sīlasampanno hoti no paraṃ adhisīle sampavattā
an5.106:3.5: ettāvatāpi kho ānanda bhikkhusaṃgho viharanto phāsuṃ vihareyyāti.
an5.106:4.1: siyā pana bhante aññopi pariyāyo yathā bhikkhusaṃgho viharanto phāsuṃ vihareyyāti.
an5.106:4.3: yato kho ānanda bhikkhu attanā ca sīlasampanno hoti no paraṃ adhisīle sampavattā
an5.106:4.5: appaññāto ca hoti tena appaññātikena no paritassati
an5.106:4.6: ettāvatāpi kho ānanda bhikkhusaṃgho viharanto phāsuṃ vihareyyāti.
an5.106:5.1: siyā pana bhante aññopi pariyāyo yathā bhikkhusaṃgho viharanto phāsuṃ vihareyyāti.
an5.106:5.3: yato kho ānanda bhikkhu attanā ca sīlasampanno hoti no paraṃ adhisīle sampavattā
an5.106:5.5: appaññāto ca hoti tena appaññātikena no paritassati
an5.106:5.6: catunnañca jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
an5.106:5.7: ettāvatā kho ānanda bhikkhusaṃgho viharanto phāsuṃ vihareyyāti.
an5.106:6.1: siyā pana bhante aññopi pariyāyo yathā bhikkhusaṃgho viharanto phāsuṃ vihareyyāti.
an5.106:6.3: yato kho ānanda bhikkhu attanā ca sīlasampanno hoti no paraṃ adhisīle sampavattā
an5.106:6.5: appaññāto ca hoti tena appaññātikena no paritassati
an5.106:6.6: catunnañca jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
an5.106:6.7: āsavānañca khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati
an5.106:6.8: ettāvatā kho ānanda bhikkhusaṃgho viharanto phāsuṃ vihareyya.
an5.106:7.1: imamhā cāhaṃ ānanda phāsuvihārā añño phāsuvihāro uttaritaro vā paṇītataro vā natthīti vadāmīti.
